result.summary: Found 1 major content issue on the page: a duplicate restaurant card is displayed in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant card 'Green Bowl Poké' (with identical image, delivery time '15–25 min', and '€0.90 delivery' fee) is duplicated consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the items returned or rendered in the 'Fastest near you' carousel so each restaurant appears only once.
